title: Two Skeletons Nobody Is Allowed to Test #shorts
description:
In 1674 two children's skeletons were found under a stair in the Tower of London and buried as the Princes in the Tower. A 1933 examination couldn't tell their sex or century, and requests for modern testing, including DNA, have been refused.

Full investigation on the channel: Did Richard III Kill the Princes in the Tower? I'm 49% Sure

Sources: Westminster Abbey; Tanner & Wright (1933). Images: Buck brothers engraving, Millais (1878), public domain.

Narration and visuals are AI-generated.
